hero.headline: Built on Experience, Driven by Pride
hero.body: A local contractor who treats every home like his own.

story.title: Our Story
story.body1: Barea's Home Services was founded by a veteran contractor with hands-on experience in home improvement and construction across Florida. After spending years building a reputation working for an established contracting firm, the decision was made to bring that same level of professionalism and quality directly to Tampa Bay homeowners.
story.body2: We believe every homeowner deserves a contractor who shows up on time, communicates clearly, and delivers what they promise. Being bilingual means we can serve both English and Spanish-speaking families in our community — and that matters to us deeply.

items.title: Honesty First
items.body: We give you straight answers and honest estimates. No bait-and-switch, no surprise charges.

items.title: Clean Jobsites
items.body: We respect your home. Every crew member is trained to leave the site clean at the end of each day.

items.title: We Show Up
items.body: We do what we say, when we say. Our reputation depends on it.

items.title: Quality Materials
items.body: We source quality materials and never cut corners that affect the longevity of your project.

credentials.title: Credentials & Coverage
credentials.insuranceDetail: Fully insured — your property is protected.
